programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is visiting Japan.He decides to meet the doll woman.So she goes to Tokyo, where she meets a man who is in love with Megumi.Practical Japanese people increasingly replace true love in this way.They even marry artificial women.According to estimates, there are as many as twenty thousand men in the Land of the Rising Sun who have such a doll.Their size, weight and appearance reflect humans.The traveler is looking for answers to the questions whether it is possible to fall in love with a doll and whether it is an image of the future.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska reaches Ghana, where she takes part in an important event - a funeral.In this country, the social status of the deceased is determined by the way of mourning, the number of mourners and the shape of the coffin.Veronica is a professional crier.He supports himself and his sons from his salary.It offers clients, among others:crying with falling to the ground, convulsions or squirrel crying.The traveler also talks to Paa Joe - a world-famous coffin artist.His work was purchased, for example, by Jimmy Carter, the president of the United States.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is going to Austria.There he meets an extraordinary gymnast, Jennifer Bricker-Bauer, who... was born without legs.Shortly after being born, she was abandoned in the hospital.Her adoptive parents gave her a great will to fight and also taught her not to use words such as "I can't", "I can't do it" or "I can't".She reached for the dreams that were within her reach and achieved success.Now he infects others with his optimism and motivates them.The story of the heroine of the third episode is a great example that the best scripts are written by life, and insurmountable barriers simply do not exist.
